content.comment_body: Hello everyone! The upgrade process does not start after I reload the device with the firmware and basic program on the memory card as described in the upgrade guide. After the reload, the device only shows the admin menu screen—no changes occur. Does anyone have suggestions? Current firmware: [product_name] [version_no] [version_no]. Downloaded file: [product_name]_fw_[version_no]_up_bm.zip. Using Transcend Class10 MicroSD 32GB formatted with FAT32.

You are attempting to update a [product_name] [version_no] (firmware [version_no]) with an update file intended for [product_name] [version_no] ([version_no]). This method is incompatible. The firmware [version_no] is the latest available for your [product_name] [version_no].

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced difficulties initiating a firmware upgrade on [product_name] [version_no] hardware, with no change observed after following upgrade instructions. Another community member pointed out the user selected a firmware package incompatible with their device version, highlighting potential confusion with version compatibility and upgrade procedures.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the firmware upgrade process to be straightforward, hoping that using the provided update package and following instructions would reliably result in a successful update, with clear system feedback indicating progress or errors.
